data.description:
About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

Our client is the first real estate company launched and designed for the marketplace of tomorrow. They grew from the #1 ranked sales team in New York City into a full-service firm that is revolutionizing the traditional real estate model.

At our client's firm, they do things differently. Their in-house production and branding teams develop disruptive content that engages the market by exploring new creative frontiers and redefining pathways to connect. Their tech-powered innovation platform gives their listings unparalleled exposure by reaching more buyers than anyone else. Their agents are driven to succeed, understanding of client needs, and trained to balance established sales strategies and techniques with innovative thinking.


Job Summary

Our client is looking for a Frontend-Leaning Software Engineer to join their product team. While their current engineering bench is deeply rooted in backend architecture, they are looking for a specialist to bridge the gap between robust data structures and a world-class user interface.

They need a "browser-first" engineer—someone who is obsessed with the user's experience, highly skilled in modern CSS and styling, and capable of navigating a modern full-stack ecosystem without losing sight of pixel-perfect execution. You will partner closely with a backend-focused team to transform complex data into seamless, elegant interfaces, ensuring every interaction feels intuitive, performant, and visually exceptional while elevating frontend standards across the platform.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate and develop the frontend for our client's core platforms, ensuring they meet the high aesthetic standards of the brand.

  • Master the Styles: Take full ownership of CSS, layout, and responsive design, ensuring applications are fluid, performant, and visually stunning.

  • Collaborate Across the Stack: Work closely with a backend-heavy team to integrate APIs and data models into a seamless, intuitive frontend experience.

  • Component Architecture: Build and maintain a scalable, reusable UI library that allows for rapid feature iteration across Next.js and SvelteKit environments.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on frontend development.

  • Expert-level proficiency in React, Next.js, and TypeScript.

  • Mastery of HTML5, CSS3, and TypeScript.

  • Proven experience building complex, responsive web applications from scratch.

  • Strong communication skills, you’ll be the primary advocate for frontend excellence on our client's team.

  • Comfortable working across the stack when needed (Node.js, APIs, PostgreSQL).

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

Apply now!

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/senior-front-end-engineer-nextjsreact-real-estate-santo-domingo-truelogic

experience_requirements.text: 10+ years of experience as a software engineer

data.description:
About the team

Resolve helps B2B merchants automate their net terms and accounts receivable, so they can increase sales, reduce non-payment, and minimize risk across their customer portfolio. We’ve processed hundreds of millions of dollars for thousands of businesses.

We’re a team of product-oriented engineers who partner closely with our customers & internal cross-functional teams (design, product & ops) to solve challenging business problems. We believe in leading with “context - not control”. Past projects have included building payment & banking rails that process millions of dollars, ERP and E-commerce integrations e.g. (Netsuite, Shopify, QuickBooks), developing new risk underwriting models & technologies, and exploring how AI can save our users time.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for a seasoned technical leader who’s excited to solve business problems with your technical expertise.

  • Own problems end-to-end from engaging directly with cross-functional stakeholders to thinking through everything from business impact, speed vs scope tradeoffs, reliability and operability, to ensuring “post-release success”.

  • Scope and lead large technical projects with enormous impact across the company

  • Advise Resolve leadership on key technology and product roadmap considerations

  • Participate in strategic planning and contribute to decision-making processes

  • Improve engineering standards, tooling, and processes

  • Build a culture of technical excellence

Who you are

  • 10+ years of experience as a software engineer

  • Comfortable being truly full-stack with hands-on experience in back-end and front-end development

  • Outcomes driven. You see the value in setting clear objectives, planning strategically, focusing on the impact of what you’ve built, and adapting to any changes that may be required.

  • Enjoy bringing projects from 0 to 1

  • Decisive and thoughtful with your actions

  • A strong sense of ownership. You take pride in what you build, and you hold yourself accountable for the quality of your contributions.

  • Ability to communicate your ideas and approach to solving problems with clarity

  • Ability to work well cross-functionally and earn trust from co-workers at all levels

  • Leads by example and has experience mentoring and growing senior engineers as their technical leader

Bonus points

  • Experience in fintech or financial services

  • Experience in startups

  • Demonstrated ability to manage, analyze, and draw actionable insights from large datasets using data analysis tools and techniques

  • NodeJS, React and SQL experience

What we offer

  • Competitive pay

  • Strong team culture fueled by humble horsepower

  • Fully remote & flexible work environment

  • Company offsites: our strategic planning sessions are held in-person

  • 100% paid healthcare/dental/vision coverage for employee (70% base coverage for dependents)

  • 401(k) plan

  • Meaningful equity stock options

  • Paid parental leave

  • Unlimited PTO

  • WFH stipend

  • Learning and Development resources

Resolve is shaped by a strong respect for each other. This applies to every aspect of employment – from equitable wages, work-life balance, the freedom to be your whole self, to equal opportunities for growth and development at Resolve. We believe wholeheartedly the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We believe strongly that we benefit from diversity and encourage applicants from underrepresented backgrounds to apply. We prefer candidates who are based in the United States or Canada.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/staff-software-engineer-resolve

data.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
data.description:
What is the position?

As SeniorFull Stack Developer, you know all there is to know about software development.You are passionate about the backend of applications as well as the frontend ofthe system. Through your understanding of databases, servers and clients, you havea holistic view on the architecture of the complete system. You know and use awide range of different technologies and languages to develop applications.

What are you going to do?

You will be working on different softwareprojects with an experienced team. Together with the team, you will determinethe technical approach to solve an issue, code the technical solution and test thecode quality. Your daily activity will be to produce scalable softwaresolutions, as well as maintaining or upgrading existing solutions. As a thoughtleader and expert of different technologies, you understand the differentapproaches we can take and you will provide your professional expertise onarchitecture (both server-side and client-side) and execution. You will also shareyour vision on technological opportunities you get excited about.

At XABLU, team is our number onepriority. Therefore, you will also provide code reviews and receive code reviewsfrom colleagues. As a team, you will carry the responsibility for the technicalarchitecture, code quality and final deliverables.

Who are we lookingfor?

You have a vision on where we should move to and how to getthere.Your extensive knowledge of both frontend and backendtechnologies allow you to design both client-side and server-side architecture.You have excellent communication skills and can easily work together with colleagues,product owners and clients. You have an eye for detail and are extremelymotivated to fix any bug that might come along. You can develop and managewell-functioning databases and applications. You are intrigued by thepossibilities of API’s and microservices. Moreover, you document your code welland invest in technical documentation so the team is always on the same page,also in the future.

We are looking for a grounded person who keeps calm during busy days and is able toreflect this on others. When there is some quick solution thinking necessary,you already have some options in mind and ready to share it with the team. Youknow how to provide guidance to others, not just because you have the knowledgeavailable but also because it comes naturally to you.

Who is XABLU?

data.title: Senior iOS Developer - Swift, Kotlin Multiplatform & AI Coding
data.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

Job Description:

PRINCIPAL AI AUTONOMY SYSTEMS INTEGRATOR (UAS / SWARMING / C2 / EDGE AI)

Hands‑On Engineering • Autonomous System Integration • Mission‑Thread Enablement

Itegrate autonomy software with real assets, validate behaviors in simulation and field environments, and ensure that autonomous agents act over trusted data, in real time, under real mission pressures.

MISSION & IMPACT

Autonomy Integration & System Engineering

  • Integrate autonomy stacks onto UAS, multi‑vehicle swarms, and robotic platforms, including navigation, perception, cooperative behaviors, and distributed decision-making.
  • Implement real‑time autonomy pipelines that incorporate sensing, fusion, planning, and control across diverse air/ground systems.
  • Adapt and optimize autonomy algorithms for constrained edge environments (embedded systems, GPUs/VPUs, tactical compute nodes).

Data‑ and Knowledge‑Aligned Autonomy

  • Build data pipelines and semantic alignment layers so autonomous systems operate against trusted, structured, and meaning‑preserving data representations.
  • Integrate autonomy with ontology-driven or schema-governed data models to ensure consistent entity tracking, mission-state representation, and decision context.
  • Enable retrieval‑grounded behaviors where autonomous agents act based on authoritative, updated, and fused situational information.

Edge Deployment Across Contested Environments

  • Deploy AI/ML models and autonomy services to edge compute environments (K3s/RKE2, containers, bare metal).
  • Harden autonomy behaviors for degraded communications, GPS denial, EW threats, sensor loss, and variable latency.
  • Implement resilient synchronization patterns between edge devices and enterprise/tactical nodes.

Simulation, Experimentation, and Field Testing

  • Conduct structured field experiments with unmanned vehicles, swarms, multi‑agent behaviors, and C2 workflows.
  • Validate mission‑thread performance across detection, tasking, coordination, and operator-in-the-loop behaviors.

Agentic Workflow Integration

  • Integrate agent frameworks enabling autonomy agents to plan, coordinate, task, and interact with mission tools and human operators.
  • Define safety gates, oversight mechanisms, and deterministic tool‑use patterns that support “human‑on‑the‑loop” operations.
  • Support multi‑agent cooperation through standard APIs and interoperable messaging patterns.

C2, Networks, and Cross‑Domain Integration

  • Integrate autonomous systems with tactical C2 platforms, data links, secure communications, and multi‑domain operational workflows.
  • Implement open standards (MOSA, SOSA, CMOSS, open messaging protocols) for plug‑and‑play component integration.
  • Enable interoperability across joint, partner‑nation, and coalition environments with appropriate policy controls.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build full autonomy pipelines end‑to‑end, from sensing through action execution.
  • Deploy CV, tracking, SLAM, pattern‑learning, anomaly detection, and cooperative‑agent models on real unmanned systems.
  • Integrate heterogeneous sensors, radios, and payloads with autonomy decision loops.
  • Conduct troubleshooting and rapid problem resolution across autonomy software, embedded systems, edge clusters, and C2 interfaces.
  • Translate mission problems into executable autonomy behaviors and scenario‑specific workflows.
  • Train teams and mission personnel on system configuration, safety, deployment, and best practices.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

Core Background

  • Education: BA/BS or equivalent
  • Experience: 10+ years in unmanned systems, autonomy engineering, robotics integration, or embedded AI/ML deployment.
  • Direct experience integrating autonomy into UAS, drones, swarms, robotic vehicles, or similar platforms.
  • Strong proficiency in C++, Python, and real‑time/embedded software patterns.

Technical Expertise

  • Autonomy functions: motion planning, cooperative behaviors, obstacle avoidance, distributed coordination, sensor fusion, and real‑time decision-making.
  • Robotics frameworks: ROS/ROS2, PX4/ArduPilot, MAVLink, simulation tools (Gazebo, AirSim, custom environments).
  • AI/ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, JAX.
  • Edge compute: NVIDIA Jetson, VPUs, ruggedized x86 nodes, tactical accelerators.
  • Containerization and DevSecOps: Docker, Kubernetes (K3s/RKE2), GitLab CI, ArgoCD.
  • Interoperability standards: open architectures, modular interfaces, secure API design.

Domain Understanding

  • Experience supporting C2 integration, tactical networks, and degraded-communication workflows.
  • Understanding of multi‑domain mission threads such as ISR, counter‑UAS, logistics autonomy, multi-agent coordination, and decision-support.
  • Experience designing resilient behavior under environmental, adversarial, and operational stressors.

Security Requirements

  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • Top Secret/SCI Required to start

DESIRED EXPERIENCE

  • Experience with distributed track fusion, detection/classification pipelines, or multi-sensor correlation.
  • Familiarity with mission‑partner interoperability and cross‑domain data release patterns.
  • Experience implementing provenance, auditability, and safety‑bounded autonomy behaviors.
  • Background in private 5G, tactical mesh networking, or mobile operations centers.

WHY THIS ROLE IS UNIQUE

This Principal-level role is tailored for someone who:

  • Builds autonomy that works in real field conditions, not just in demos.
  • Bridges AI models, mission data, and real unmanned systems.
  • Ensures autonomous behaviors are grounded in trusted, structured information.
  • Understands both the engineering and the operational realities of deploying autonomy at scale.

You are the person who makes autonomous systems reliable, interoperable, safe, and mission-ready.

You have deep full-stack engineering experience and a track record of shipping customer-facing features in a high-growth environment

data.title: Senior Software Safety Engineer, Halos - Autonomous Vehicles
data.description:
NVIDIA is widely regarded as a leading company in technology. It has groundbreaking developments in High-Performance Computing, Artificial Intelligence, and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work enables exploration of new universes, enables outstanding creativity and discoveries that were once science fiction from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars and robotics.

NVIDIA Halos is the full-stack, comprehensive safety system that unifies autonomous machines architecture, AI models, chips, software, tools, and services to ensure the safe development and deployment of Physical AI. We are actively seeking a Senior SW Safety Engineer to join the Halos team and collaborate closely with other teams across NVIDIA working on autonomous vehicle and robotics safety.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Be pivotal in ensuring the safety of our AI-based autonomous system software.
  • Engage with a diverse team of engineers across the entire DRIVE platform and related research unit. You will work closely with the groups handling automotive functional safety and safety of the intended functionality.
  • Collaborate with the teams dedicated to robotics, humanoids, industry safety and other safety critical applications across NVIDIA.
  • Apply your skills to guide the teams to specify, build, implement, and verify safety requirements across our software stack from drivers and acceleration libraries to AI-based technologies, including end-to-end models.
  • Help NVIDIA team implementing our Product Life Cycle to integrate the process principles of AI safety.
  • Your role includes engaging in customer interaction and international standardization activities related to safety of Artificial Intelligence.
  • Support system safety activities including decomposition of safety requirements, system and component level build analysis (FTA, DFA, CCF, FMEA, etc.), and architectural safety analysis across hardware and software boundaries.
  • Collaborate with external certification bodies, assessors, and regulators. You will present, defend, and justify safety arguments and evidence. This supports successful safety certification reviews related to functionality and AI.

What we need to see:

  • BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical field, or equivalent experience.
  • 12+ years of shown experience in Artificial Intelligence and SW safety related processes, methodologies, tools.
  • Experience in AI safety methods and tools (adaptability testing, uncertainty evaluation, out of distribution detection, and other related methods).
  • Familiarity with system software development and embedded platforms.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience in reviewing existing processes and finding gaps to suggest improvements.
  • Experience producing safety plans, safety analyses reports, safety case documentation, and evidence packets in support of safety certification and audit activities.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • Strong background in safety standards (ISO PAS 8800, ISO/IEC TR 5469, ISO 21448, ISO 26262, IEC 61508).
  • Background in system safety methodologies & practices (HARA, FMEA, FTA, STPA).
  • Hands-on experience with innovative systems engineering methodologies – such as requirements management, peer review processes, configuration management, requirements management in an agile development environment, risk management, requirements verification and traceability, validation and verification, and architectural decomposition.
  • Hands-on experience in autonomous systems.

data.title: Full Stack Developer
data.description:
Who we are:

Magellan AI gives brands, agencies and publishers visibility into the podcast advertising market and proof that it works. Our audio analysis and NLP track ad placements across thousands of shows. Our measurement and attribution tools connect those ads to the traffic and conversions they drive, so buyers can optimize campaigns and sellers can prove performance.

We are looking to hire an experienced full-stack developer to join our team of seven engineers, to help launch a major new feature and continue to enhance our core product. The job has changed shape over the past year: most of our code is now drafted by AI agents — Claude Code and Codex — working under close supervision. We ship considerably more than we used to, and the scarce skill is no longer typing speed. It is knowing what to build, specifying it precisely, and being able to tell a correct answer from a convincing one. We are seeking someone who can handle many responsibilities, including:

  • Adding new features to our Ruby on Rails application from top-to-bottom, full stack. You will work with operations and sales to help creatively design ‘good enough’ yet professional solutions.
  • Directing AI coding agents through real work: framing the problem and its constraints, reviewing what comes back line by line, pushing back when a solution has outgrown the problem, and starting over simpler when that is the right call. You own the result regardless of who typed it.
  • Increasing system/code quality by using practices such as TDD and refactoring. Quality around the core of the system has become more important as we scale up — and more important still now that the volume of code we produce has gone up.
  • Writing the design down before the code: specs, architecture decision records, and product documentation for our operations team. Precise writing is a core engineering skill here, because it is both how we align with each other and how we brief our agents.
  • Extending our own tooling — the skills, subagents and CLI helpers that encode how we work. Codifying a workflow so the whole team, and their agents, can repeat it is ordinary, reviewed work here.
  • Building AI-facing product surfaces, like our Ad Intelligence MCP server, where the consumer of the API you design is a language model rather than a browser — with the authentication, policy gates and audit logging that implies.
  • Enhancing usability of existing features via Turbo/Stimulus and other front-end improvements.
  • Troubleshooting and fixing performance issues and complicated logic across Postgres and ClickHouse. Help simplify the system by bringing in smart design decisions.
  • Experimenting and providing stopgap solutions for potential opportunities. Sometimes this involves quick and dirty solutions such as scripting, SQL exports, web scraping and the like.
  • Sharing in providing operational support to make sure the system stays running and address any bugs. (Most usage is during normal business hours…we don’t do pagers.)
  • Experimenting via internal hackathons to produce novel solutions and feature enhancements.

Software Development at Magellan AI

We adhere to a lightweight Agile development process.

  • Every week, we have one formal product meeting with the revenue and operations team to reset priorities. The rest of the time is self-directed, with developers figuring out how to best solve any problems. In general, we are not working against any deadlines and make sure we take the time to do the job right.
  • We practice Collective Code Ownership so that anyone can change any line of code and anyone can introduce new libraries or tools.
  • We deploy code on a regular basis, usually every day. IOW, we ship fast and learn fast. A typical recent week is around 45 pull requests merged.
  • Claude Code and Codex do most of the typing. Engineers spend their time deciding what to build, writing the spec, and judging what comes back.
  • We work one task per git worktree, which lets each of us keep several agent sessions running in parallel on isolated branches. Managing that parallelism is a skill in itself, and we will teach it.
  • Every change runs a review gauntlet before it merges: a local pre-PR review, a cross-agent review where Codex critiques Claude’s work, GitHub Copilot’s automated review (our branch rules will not let us merge until every thread is resolved), and a human reviewer. Different models catch different things.
  • We invest heavily in the context our agents read: a repository-level conventions file, roughly two dozen project-specific skills, and purpose-built subagents. When someone learns something the hard way, it gets written down where the next agent will find it.
  • Decisions get recorded as ADRs — we are up to 159 — and business rules live in a shared documentation repository linked into every worktree, so both people and agents can find out why the system works the way it does.
  • We usually host a biweekly team retrospective to discuss ways to improve communication and collaboration.
  • We make it easy for the tech-adjacent team members to run QA with clear documentation and steps to test our work.

Tools and Technologies

The main application is Ruby on Rails, hosted on Heroku, with Postgres as the primary database and ClickHouse behind our measurement and attribution product. Background work runs on Sidekiq. JavaScript in the application is minimal, and is mostly Turbo and Stimulus with some Bootstrap. A separate Python application handles all of the machine learning. Infrastructure is managed in Terraform across AWS, GCP and Cloudflare. Day to day we work in Claude Code and Codex, with MCP servers wired into ClickHouse, Postgres, New Relic, Rollbar, CircleCI and Trello so our agents can gather their own evidence.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of software development experience
  • Expertise with Agile web development, with practices such as TDD and Refactoring
  • Fluency working with AI coding agents day to day, or the obvious appetite for it. You do not need our exact toolchain, but you should be someone who reviews what an agent hands you rather than trusting it.
  • Clear writing. You will be writing specs, ADRs and documentation read by people who are not engineers.

Nice to Have:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • ClickHouse
  • Python
  • NYC-based
  • Experience designing MCP servers or other LLM-facing APIs
  • Background in ad tech
  • Interest in the podcasting world

Compensation and benefits:

  • Competitive base salary and bonus structure
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage - individual coverage is free
  • Company-subsidized family coverage
  • Home office improvement reimbursement up to $500 per year
  • Company laptop and external monitor
  • 11 company holidays
  • 20 PTO days for vacation, illness, and personal time

More about Magellan AI

Magellan AI is a first mover, early-stage SaaS startup funded by Brooklyn Bridge Ventures, C2 ventures and a few independent investors. The company was founded in 2016 by Cameron Hendrix (formerly Goldman Sachs) and Rex Madden (formerly Stride Consulting NYC). Magellan AI is the all-in-one platform for audio advertising intelligence, media planning, and measurement. Advertiser and agency media buyers rely on Magellan AI's audio media planning and measurement platform to discover, connect with, and analyze the performance of broadcast radio, podcasts, streaming audio, and YouTube. Publishers trust Magellan AI to grow audio ad sales with intelligence and performance measurement, powered by the world's largest database of podcast advertising data, covering over 60,000 podcasts. You will have the chance to shape the direction of a popular product in a rapidly evolving industry.

We’re a remote-first company (though we’re still based in NYC). We offer great benefits for our size (medical, dental, equipment stipend, vacation), off-site retreats, as well as a generous options grant.

Magellan AI is an equal opportunity employer; in keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on gender, sexual orientation, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, marital domestic partner status, physical ability, gender identity, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on 'protected categories,' we also strive to prevent other, subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (e.g., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our company culture. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at Magellan AI.

Salary: $100,000 – $140,000 / year

About the Team

The Role

As a Senior Staff Security Software Engineer on the Agentic Security Engineering team, you will be a senior technical authority and architect for Databricks’ shared Security AI platform.

You will define the platform architecture, technical standards, and multi-year engineering direction that allow security teams to build, deploy, and operate governed AI personas safely at scale. Your work will span secure agent identity, isolation and sandboxing, policy enforcement, auditability, observability, evaluation, orchestration, and reliable integration with Databricks and security infrastructure.

You will operate across organizational boundaries, aligning engineering and security leaders on platform architecture, driving adoption of common patterns, and resolving complex technical problems that affect multiple security functions. You will influence the quality, safety, reliability, and velocity of the broader Security AI ecosystem without owning the domain logic or business outcomes of every individual persona.

EnableComp provides Specialty Revenue Cycle Management solutions for healthcare organizations, leveraging over 24 years of industry-leading expertise and its unified E360 RCM™ intelligent automation platform to improve financial sustainability for hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) nationwide. Position Summary

The AI Engineer is a hands-on individual contributor who builds, trains, and evaluates machine learning models. The role combines knowledge engineering and data analysis with applied reinforcement learning, and owns work end to end, from data and experiment design through training, evaluation, and reporting.

The ideal candidate brings practical reinforcement learning experience, strong engineering discipline, and the ability to collaborate closely with domain experts and communicate results to technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with domain experts to capture specialized knowledge and represent it in structured, usable form.
  • Analyze source material and datasets for quality, consistency, and coverage, and resolve issues with the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Perform exploratory and statistical analysis to inform data, modeling, and evaluation decisions.
  • Create and curate training and evaluation datasets, using both automated and human validation.
  • Design reinforcement learning environments, reward functions, and verifiers.
  • Train and fine-tune language models using supervised and reinforcement learning methods such as PPO, DPO, and GRPO.
  • Establish baselines, run ablations, and diagnose training issues such as reward hacking, instability, and data leakage.
  • Follow the research literature and bring promising techniques into practice.
  • Manage experiments rigorously, including versioned configurations, reproducible runs, experiment tracking, and compute budgeting.
  • Design and extend evaluation frameworks, metrics, and benchmarks.
  • Compare models and approaches through structured experiments and A/B testing.
  • Document results, failures, and next steps in clear technical write-ups.
  • Present findings to engineers, domain experts, and business leaders in language each audience can act on.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, machine learning, statistics, or a related field; MS or PhD preferred. Equivalent hands-on experience will be considered.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience training or fine-tuning language models.

  • Working knowledge of policy optimization methods for language models, such as PPO, DPO, or GRPO, including their failure modes.
  • Strong Python and PyTorch skills, with fluency in the Hugging Face ecosystem and parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques.

  • Experience with knowledge representation approaches such as knowledge graphs or ontologies is highly preferred.
  • Experience generating and validating synthetic data for model training is highly preferred.
  • Publications or open-source contributions in reinforcement learning, language model fine-tuning, or model evaluation is highly preferred.
  • Experience handling sensitive data, including protected health information (PHI) under HIPAA is highly preferred.
  • Timely and regular attendance.

  • To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Special Considerations and Prerequisites

data.description:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

About the role

We’re looking for an exceptional Full Stack Engineer to help us build, optimize, and expand the foundation of the platform.

We’ve kept our hiring standards exceptionally high since we expect engineers to tackle a broad range of challenges on a day-to-day basis. Examples of past engineering initiatives include developing strategies for secret rotation and dynamic secrets, a gateway to provide secure access to private resources, protocols like EST and KMIP, integrations for syncing secrets across cloud providers, and entire new product lines such as Infisical PKI and Infisical PAM.

You’ll be working closely with our CTO and the rest of the engineering team to:

  • Develop and maintain features whilst communicating directly with enterprise customers.

  • Expand our newer Infisical PKI, Infisical PAM, and Infisical KMS product lines.

  • Experiment with novel approaches for applying AI to secrets management and more broadly security infrastructure.

Requirements

  • Deep technical mastery of the JavaScript ecosystem, particularly React.js, Node.js, and TypeScript.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and eager to learn.

  • A bias toward action—able to make decisions with incomplete information, iterate quickly, and take calculated risks.

  • Based in the Americas (US or Canada), Brazil, India, UK, or EU. Must work US hours.

Nice to have

  • Expertise in Go.

  • Has some understanding of devops/developer tools.

  • Previous founder or startup experience.

  • Previous experience building in open source or developer tools in either a professional or personal setting.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills to interact with customers directly.

Team, values & benefits

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page.

data.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Canvas Core team builds and maintains the foundational platform that powers Mural’s visual thinking experience. This includes the infinite canvas, key editor components, document editing behaviors, asset management, real-time collaboration, and the systems that enable fast, reliable, and intuitive interaction on the canvas.

We’re also responsible for the Mural UI, the real-time message protocol that enables seamless remote collaboration, and the developer-friendly APIs that internal teams use to build features like diagramming, workshops, presentations, integrations, and AI-enabled product capabilities.

Our mission is to ensure the Mural editor is fast, reliable, intuitive, and easy to build on.

We prioritize performance, simplicity, developer experience, and platform quality, enabling teams across the company to ship quickly and safely on top of Canvas Core.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll help design, build, and improve the Canvas platform so that the Mural editor remains reliable, high-performing, and intuitive for our users.

You’ll work on the systems that power real-time collaboration, shared document editing, spatial interactions, rendering and interaction performance, asset management, developer APIs, and AI-enabled product capabilities across the Mural editor.

Your role will be to reduce platform complexity, improve the quality and speed of Canvas development, and help teams ship high-quality editor experiences quickly and safely. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and other stakeholders to turn ambiguous product and platform problems into clear, maintainable technical solutions.

Senior Engineers at Mural lead by example through strong technical execution, thoughtful design, high-quality implementation, and collaborative problem-solving. They help raise the bar for their team through design discussions, code reviews, mentoring, documentation, and pragmatic improvements to engineering practices.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own and deliver new Canvas platform capabilities and improvements from problem definition through implementation, release, measurement, and iteration

  • Partner with Product and Design to shape high-quality user experiences, balancing pragmatic technical delivery with long-term platform needs

  • Design and build maintainable Canvas platform systems, with accountability for quality, performance, reliability, and developer experience

  • Contribute to developer-friendly APIs, service boundaries, and platform contracts that internal teams can build on quickly and safely

  • Use AI-assisted tools and agentic workflows as part of your engineering practice to prototype, implement, test, document, and measure work effectively

  • Strengthen the team through technical design reviews, demos, code reviews, mentoring, and improvements to engineering practices

  • Build and evolve canvas systems with rich document and object models, including hierarchical scene or document structures, spatial indexing and querying, layout behavior, asset management, and selection mechanics

  • Work on large-scale concurrent and real-time collaboration systems that keep shared documents synchronized across users, contributing to design decisions around event ordering, latency, conflict handling, and failure-mode management

  • Help design, build, and integrate AI-enabled product capabilities where they intersect with the canvas, document model, real-time collaboration systems, or developer platform

  • Improve performance through profiling, bottleneck analysis, architectural simplification, targeted optimization, and moving expensive work out of critical interaction paths so systems remain responsive as document complexity and user activity scale

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Fluency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript, with familiarity in React, Node.js, or comparable modern frameworks

  • 6+ years building and shipping large-scale production software as part of an agile engineering team

  • Strong engineering judgment, with experience designing and delivering scalable, reliable, high-performance systems and developer-facing abstractions that balance simplicity, developer experience, and long-term maintainability

  • Experience designing clean API contracts and service boundaries, including thoughtful data models, versioning, validation, error handling, documentation, and long-term maintainability

  • Experience building distributed, concurrent, collaborative, or low-latency systems, such as collaboration tools, MMO games, shared-state systems, messaging protocols, or other low-latency user experiences, with familiarity across synchronization, consistency, event ordering, latency, failure modes, and performance trade-offs

  • Exposure to complex systems with rich object models, including hierarchical scene or document structures, spatial indexing and querying, layout behavior, asset management, selection mechanics, and performance-sensitive user interactions is a strong plus

  • Interest in AI-enabled product capabilities, or hands-on experience building or integrating them in production, such as intelligent editing, automation, recommendations, semantic document understanding, or collaboration features powered by AI

  • Performance optimization experience, including profiling, bottleneck analysis, memory and CPU efficiency, latency reduction, and responsiveness as document complexity and user activity scale

  • Familiarity with parallel processing, off-main-thread architectures, rendering pipelines, background computation, or other multithreaded systems is a plus

  • Practical experience using AI-assisted tools to prototype, implement, test, document, and measure engineering work

  • Communication and collaboration skills, with a low-ego approach to working with Product, Design, and Engineering, and the ability to contribute meaningfully to technical discussions, collaborate across teams, and help improve team engineering practices

  • Comfort operating in high-growth, fast-paced environments or scale-ups is a plus

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Admin & Identity and Access Management (Admin & IAM) team at Mural defines how users sign in, manage their identities, and access Mural's products, as well as how administrators configure and govern their organizations. We own authentication & authorization, Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), user provisioning (SCIM), session management, and the core permission model that powers roles and access control across companies and workspaces. We also own the enterprise administration experience; the configuration and controls that company and workspace admins use to manage their organizations and users. By providing secure, clear, and intuitive controls for users and administrators, we help organizations adopt Mural quickly and collaborate with confidence.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Admin & IAM team, you will design and ship these capabilities end-to-end, from identity primitives like the permission model and authentication flows to the admin surfaces enterprise customers use every day. Senior Engineers on Admin & IAM own complex technical initiatives, influence platform and security best practices, and collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Infrastructure to deliver secure experiences that feel simple and intuitive. You will report to an Engineering Manager and work with a small, focused team in a remote-first environment, with the option to work from our Buenos Aires office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and evolve core identity and access systems that power authentication & authorization, SSO, user provisioning, session management, and permissions across Mural

  • Build and evolve the enterprise administration experience, including company and workspace configuration, user and content administration, billing, and internal admin tooling

  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners to design and ship secure, intuitive access and administration experiences for users and administrators

  • Prototype, implement, and maintain Admin & IAM platform features, contributing as a technical expert and supporting teammates through collaboration and mentorship

data.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (AI Agent)
data.description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the role:

At Cresta, the AI Agent team is on a mission to create state-of-the-art AI Agents that solve practical problems for our customers. We are focused on leveraging the latest technologies in Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI Agent systems, while ensuring that the solutions we develop are cost-effective, secure, and reliable.

As an AI Agent Engineer, you'll be at the forefront of deploying AI agents that address real-world challenges. In this role, you will work closely with customers as well as our software and machine learning engineers, ensuring high-impact AI Agent deployments and contributing to the continuous improvement of our core AI platform. You’ll develop intelligent AI agents, integrate them seamlessly with external systems and offer hands-on technical expertise to ensure successful deployments.. This position requires strong engineering skills, adaptability, and customer engagement. If you are self-driven, analytical, and eager to leverage AI in practical applications, this role is for you.

What You'll Do :

  • AI Agent Development: Develop, configure, deploy, and optimize AI agents using Cresta’s AI platform and tools.
  • System Integration: Build AI agent integrations with external systems (APIs, databases, CRMs, etc.) to ensure seamless workflow integration.
  • Performance Optimization: Optimize AI agent performance (e.g. fine-tune prompts and configurations) and troubleshoot issues in complex enterprise environments.
  • Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to gather technical requirements and translate business needs into AI Agent solutions.
  • Demos & Iteration: Conduct interactive demos and present compelling proof-of-concepts to prospective customers, proactively gather feedback, and iteratively refine solutions to meet objectives.
  • Project Coordination: Define project milestones, create implementation plans, and coordinate execution with internal teams to ensure on-time delivery. Provide a tight feedback loop to our product and engineering teams — identifying gaps, building custom tooling, and influencing the roadmap through real-world deployment learnings.
  • Partner Cross-Functionally: Collaborate with PMs to define agent goals, iterate rapidly based on customer feedback, and shape product capabilities that maximize customer ROI.
  • Technical Guidance: Serve as a trusted technical advisor for the customer, guiding best practices for AI agent adoption and usage. Provide technical guidance on AI agent best practices, including architecture design, security considerations, and scalability planning.

What We're Looking For:

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: 3+ years of full-time working experience in software development/Consulting, AI/ML engineering, or Forward Deployed Engineering.
  • Programming Skills: Proficiency in Python and Golang, with the ability to write clean, efficient code.
  • AI/ML Knowledge: Familiarity with AI/ML concepts. Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs), and prompt engineering techniques are strongly preferred.
  • AI Agent Frameworks: Strong understanding of general AI agent frameworks, function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Hands-on experience of building such a system is strongly preferred.
  • Cloud & DevOps: Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and DevOps practices (CI/CD, containerization, monitoring).
  • Integration Expertise: Hands-on experience with integrating systems via APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and project management skills.
  • Analytical Approach: Ability to use data-driven decision-making, including A/B testing and performance monitoring, to refine solutions.
  • Collaborative Builder: You thrive in cross-functional environments, working hand-in-hand with PMs and engineers to turn real customer problems into scalable AI solutions.

Note on Our Hiring Process

We highly value your time and engineering craftsmanship. To ensure a streamlined and objective process, the first step for qualified applicants following an initial resume review is a self-paced CoderPad technical assessment. This allows you to showcase your practical coding and problem-solving skills in a real-world environment before moving into conversational interview rounds.

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

  • We offer Cresta employees a variety of medical benefits designed to fit your stage of life
  • Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend
  • Paid parental leave to support you and your family

Compensation at Cresta

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

Our use of AI in recruiting: We may use AI tools in our recruiting process, which require human review and oversight. If you have questions about our use of AI or wish to opt out, please contact recruiting@cresta.ai (if you are opting out, please use the subject ‘Opt-Out’ in your email).

Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed.

Recruiting impersonation scams: We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored.

data.title: Senior Platform Engineer
data.description:
About Solace

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here.

About the Role

Good plumbing is quiet and invisible, and so is good infrastructure. As a Senior Platform Engineer at Solace, you will join our platform engineering team and help build the infrastructure powering the future of health care. You enable product and data engineers to move aggressively and deploy daily, build safeguards to autonomously recover from failures, and fix things when they can't.

You are a generalist who can work both independently and as part of a team, spanning high-level architecture and low-level foundations. You are curious and always learning. You look deeper than the surface at how systems work, how they fail, and how they can self-heal. You take pride in your craft, have impeccable communication skills, and you absorb feedback exceptionally well. You aren't afraid to make mistakes and learn more from them. Above all, you enjoy taking ownership and are stifled by large organizations.

What You'll Do

  • Help build out our cloud infrastructure and application platform

  • Assess risk and impact for changes to our live environment

  • Join our on-call rotation

  • Troubleshoot problems emerging from complex interactions of technology, governance, and people

  • Design and build autonomous self-healing processes in our systems

  • Be a resource for product and data engineers in your areas of expertise. Learn and grow into other areas of expertise.

  • Communicate with stakeholders and internal platform customers

What You Bring to the Table

Platform engineering requires a diverse and wide-ranging set of skills. We are looking for the following core skills and experiences:

  • Experience working in a start-up environment

  • Experience building scalable infrastructure for hosting web applications or data workloads

  • Deep troubleshooting. You relentlessly dig through architectural and abstraction layers to identify root causes, sometimes under time pressure. You have done this solo and in a team. You have generated and tested hypotheses. You have generated and implemented solutions.

  • Fluent on the command line and comfortable working with Linux

  • Strong communication skills

  • Cloud infrastructure. Experience working with GCP, AWS, or Azure. GCP experience preferred. Bonus for experience working with cloud landing zones. Familiar with GitOps technologies, such as Terraform.

  • Networking. Understanding VPCs, subnets, routes, peering, DNS, load balancers, L4/L7 routing, NAT gateways, CDNs, TLS, and how they all work together.

  • Observability. Integrated and worked with tools such as Datadog and OpenTelemetry for infrastructure monitoring, application performance monitoring, and database performance. Comfortable helping instrument application code, building dashboards, and working with application engineers.

And One or More of the Following Focus Areas:

  • Site reliability. You have improved performance, reliability, and cost across the entire stack, from front-end to back-end.

  • Kubernetes. Understand how to best use its self-healing and extensibility to run workloads scalably, resiliently, and securely, and fix it when it breaks.

  • Polyglot. Comfortable with different languages and learning new ones. Proficient at reading code, understanding what it does, and its operational characteristics during runtime.

  • Devops. Built, optimized, and maintained continuous integration and continuous delivery systems.

  • Developer Product Experience. You built tools and low-friction experiences for product and data engineers, designing and delivering them with a product mindset.

  • Data Infrastructure. You moved databases. Built warehouses, connectors, and replicators. Implemented access controls, optimized and fixed pipelines.

  • Distributed Systems. You built both coordination-bound and coordination-free systems and know the tradeoffs in terms of scalability, reliability, and resilience. You have worked with systems spanning multi-regions. You got your hands dirty fixing systems that collapsed.

  • Security. Worked in a highly-regulated industry such as healthcare with cloud infrastructure

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge?

We look forward to meeting you.

Fraudulent Recruitment Advisory: Solace Health will NEVER request bank details or offer employment without an interview. All legitimate communications come from official solace.health emails only or ashbyhq.com. Report suspicious activity to recruiting@solace.health or advocate@solace.health.

data.title: Director, Business Systems & AI Enablement
data.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Most companies are still talking about AI. We want someone who will put it to work.

As Director, Business Systems & AI Enablement, you'll lead how Partnerize uses technology to run a smarter, faster business. You'll own Salesforce and Asana, the core platforms our teams use every day, along with the integrations that connect them to other business systems such as NetSuite, HubSpot and DocuSign. You'll also bring enterprise AI tools like Google Gemini Enterprise into how we work, so our teams spend less time on manual work and more time on customers and growth.

You'll be a player-coach. You'll lead and develop a small team of two while rolling up your sleeves yourself. One week you might be redesigning a Salesforce sales workflow. The next, you might be building a Gemini agent that removes hours of admin from the Sales team, or presenting ROI results to the executive team.

What you'll own:

  • Business systems: the roadmap, intake, delivery and vendor relationships for Salesforce, Asana and the integrations that connect them across the business.
  • Process optimization: finding friction, redesigning workflows and making sure data stays clean as we scale.
  • AI enablement: rolling out enterprise AI, designing functional agents, driving adoption and measuring the results.

You won't be doing this alone. You'll be part of a leadership group shaping how Partnerize moves into a human-AI enabled future, with one shared goal: a workplace where people and AI do their best work together. Our Director, Product brings the vision for AI in the Partnerize platform. Our Director, Business Performance Optimization brings the framework we use to evaluate new AI opportunities and helps guide proofs of concept. Our People Success team makes sure our people grow alongside the technology. You bring it all to life across the business: working with teams to find where AI can make the biggest difference, then turning big ideas into real change in how we work every day.This role has high visibility and real autonomy. You'll have a direct line to measurable business impact.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Systems & Process Optimization

  • Salesforce & Asana ownership: Own the configuration, roadmap and health of Salesforce and Asana as our primary business platforms, ensuring they scale with the business and support clean, reliable data.
  • Integration oversight: Oversee the integrations between Salesforce and Asana and connected systems, including NetSuite, HubSpot and DocuSign, so data flows accurately across Sales, Marketing, Finance and Operations.
  • Process optimization: Find friction in how teams work and redesign processes to improve efficiency, data quality and scalability.
  • Requirements and solution design: Partner with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Finance and Operations to develop user stories, define solution designs and write clear business requirements.
  • Agile delivery: Manage intake and triage for business systems requests. Prioritize and maintain backlogs in Jira so developers can deliver smoothly.
  • Hands-on building: Personally configure, prototype and build solutions (e.g., Salesforce Flows, Asana workflows, Gemini agents) alongside your team.
  • Testing and quality: Own the strategy and execution of user acceptance testing (UAT) so delivered solutions meet business requirements.
  • Change management and enablement: Lead end-user training, documentation, process flows, data dictionaries and communications for new features and workflow changes.

2. AI Enablement & Agent Adoption

This role leads internal AI adoption in close partnership with Product, Business Performance Optimization and People Success.

  • Enterprise AI platform ownership: Act as the internal product owner for enterprise AI platforms, starting with Google Gemini Enterprise. Manage rollouts, end-user enablement, prompt templates and feature adoption.
  • Agent and workflow design: Lead the design, testing and deployment of functional, business-led agents and automated multi-step workflows that remove manual work across teams.
  • AI embedded in core systems: Identify opportunities to embed AI and automation directly into Salesforce and Asana workflows, not just alongside them.
  • AI opportunity delivery: Work with business teams to find high-impact AI use cases. Take them through the Business Performance Optimization evaluation framework, partner on proofs of concept, and lead approved tools from pilot to full rollout.
  • AI governance: Put responsible-use guidelines, data security practices and access controls into practice for internal AI tools, in partnership with IT, Security and Legal.
  • Impact measurement: Define, track and report on business outcomes such as hours saved, cycle-time reduction and adoption rates, with seat utilization as one input, to show the ROI of AI across departments.

3. Leadership & Strategy

  • Team leadership: Lead, coach and develop a team of two business systems professionals, and manage external consultants as needed. Set clear goals, run performance reviews and support ongoing growth.
  • Roadmap and prioritization: Own the consolidated Business Systems and AI roadmap across departments. Balance competing requests against company priorities, and explain "No" or "Not Yet" decisions clearly.
  • Vendor and license management: Manage relationships, SLAs and engagements with software vendors and implementation partners. Oversee renewals and license optimization to control cost.
  • Key partnerships: Work closely with the Director, Product, sharing AI learnings, tools and vendor insights so internal and product AI efforts stay aligned. Partner with the Director, Business Performance Optimization to take AI opportunities through the evaluation framework and proofs of concept to delivered, measurable business results. Work with People Success on AI skills, change readiness and how roles evolve as AI takes on more routine work.
  • Internal champion: Advocate for technology and AI modernization across the company, and communicate the value the Business Systems team delivers to executives and department heads.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: Assess the current Salesforce, Asana and integration landscape. Build relationships with key stakeholders. Deliver an initial prioritized Business Systems and AI roadmap.
  • First 6 months: Launch at least [X] functional AI agents or automated workflows in production. Establish an AI adoption and impact dashboard. Streamline intake and delivery processes.
  • First 12 months: Reach 100% active adoption of Gemini Enterprise. Show measurable time savings of [X] hours per month across teams. Present a roadmap approved by the executive team for the following year.

What You Bring

Experience

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in business systems, business process optimization or enterprise application management.
  • Experience leading, coaching or managing business analysts, systems administrators or similar roles. You enjoy building as much as leading.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Technical Skills

  • Salesforce: Deep hands-on administrator or power-user experience, including automation (e.g., Flows) and data management.
  • Asana or similar work management platforms: Experience configuring and scaling tools such as Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet or similar.
  • Integrations: Working knowledge of how core platforms connect to systems like NetSuite, HubSpot and DocuSign. A solid understanding of APIs, data models, ETL and data sync between systems.
  • AI and automation: Practical experience rolling out and driving adoption of commercial AI tools (e.g., Google Gemini Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot), including prompt design, agent or workflow building and measuring impact. Experience with automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Workato) is a plus.
  • Agile delivery: Experience managing backlogs, prioritizing sprints and writing user stories in Jira.

Leadership & Communication

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical workflows in clear business language.
  • A collaborative style, with experience delivering results through peer partnerships where ownership is shared across functions.
  • Proven ability to manage executive expectations, work through competing requests and apply prioritization frameworks with tact.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and technologies.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Salesforce certification(s) (e.g., Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Business Analyst).
  • Experience with Salesforce AI capabilities
  • Familiarity with digital, performance, affiliate or partner marketing.
  • Experience supporting users across multiple regions (EMEA, Americas, APAC).
  • Training or certification in process improvement methods (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma).

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP and Wellness Coaching
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization’s success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. Partnerize is not responsible for any charges or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

About you
